component.name: TODO BIRD
component.summary: Offline Desktop Personal Assistant & Task Manager

description.p: TODO BIRD is an offline desktop personal assistant, interactive Gantt scheduler, and task manager designed for privacy, focus, and local-first productivity.

ul.li: Interactive WBS and Gantt scheduling engine
Comprehensive task and subtask status workflow
Local-first SQLite storage for complete privacy and data sovereignty
Avocet voice companion with local-time aware greetings
Dark and light modern neumorphic themes
